$comment: Regression ceilings in gzipped bytes, checked by scripts/verify-package.mjs through .github/scripts/size-budget.mjs. Size is not a target: each ceiling sits about 15-20% above what was measured when it was set, to catch an accidental blow-up. Raise one on purpose, in the pull request that needs it, and update its reason.

..reason: Raised 2026-11-10 to 14,200 B, about 17% over the 12,136 B measured on main with rolldown 1.2.16 (12,065 B with 1.2.15), as typescript/AGENTS.md sets a ceiling: rolldown 1.2.16 reorders the entry's imports and their short local names, content unchanged, which gzip compresses 71 B worse; the 30-40 B margins this ceiling kept failed every bundler update (X-86). Raised 2026-11-10 to 12,103 B, 38 B over the 12,065 B measured then (main measured 11,967 B): 98 B for exact numbers on every path (#5448, #5529, #5530): one send that every call declares its exact numbers to and that reads its answer only with them, the lazy, number-or-members and discriminated marks (textNumberOr 34 B of it); raised 2026-11-10 to 12,005 B, 38 B over the 11,967 B measured then (main measured 11,872 B): 95 B for a resumable query stream whose reader's cancel ends a wait to resume and aborts a request asking again (#5452); raised 2026-11-09 to 11,910 B, 38 B over the 11,872 B measured then (main measured 11,648 B): 224 B for the Manifest read every CommandClient caller shares (#5485, #5538), which each caller now waits on by its own signal and fails with an error of its own, under the read's name and cause, carrying its own request id; raised 2026-11-04 to 11,650 B, 34 B over the 11,616 B measured then: the exact numbers of the access attributes (D390 D), which a snapshot query, a state read, a trace and an events query read as their text beside the state and the events, net of ApplyTags' removal; raised 2026-10-30 to 11,600 B, 31 B over the 11,569 B measured then (main measured 11,475 B): 94 B for a command whose body names its aggregate (the Manifest's idProperty), which CommandClient sends by its route without an id, a request's id checked against the body's or written into a body that names none; raised 2026-10-29 to 11,500 B, 23 B over the 11,477 B measured then (main measured 11,372 B): 43 B for the id-optional request and state read path every client takes (a command and a state read by no id, the caller's own of an aggregate whose id is its owner's), 62 B for OwnStateClient, the four reads of the caller's own, which a generated state client of such an aggregate extends beside StateClient, in the same entry; set 2026-10-28 at 11,400 B, about 2% over the 11,147 B measured then, closer than the 15-20% the other ceilings keep: the root entry is what every browser host loads, so growth past D356's CommandClient, WaitPlan with its Wow-Wait grammar, CommandRejectedError and the result's status and function-kind tables (9,007 B in October) is a decision, not drift.

./dsl.reason: Raised 2026-11-10 to 13,700 B, about 17% over the 11,731 B measured then, as typescript/AGENTS.md sets a ceiling: the module boundaries of X-88 (descriptor.ts split into descriptor.ts, fieldDescriptor.ts and semanticTypes.ts, content unchanged) cost 34 B over the 11,697 B measured before, which the 1.6% margin left would not hold across the splits to come. Raised 2026-09-25, about 18% over the 10,075 B measured then: N3 expression builders, intended growth.

./routes.reason: Set 2026-10-28, about 16% over the 6,030 B measured then: the service routes client with the HTTP sender, the problem reader and the Manifest check it shares with the root entry, kept apart from it so the root stays within its ceiling.

./testing.reason: Set 2026-10-27, about 17% over the 2,995 B measured then: the development caller and the wire builders, which load the problem module for its framework codes.
